title: Manufacturing RL | PPO PQN GRPO GSPO Comparison

list.name: run_id
list.query: SELECT run_id AS __value,(metadata->>'name')||' | '||run_id AS __text FROM extended_runs WHERE metadata->>'name'='multi_rl' ORDER BY metadata->>'created_at' DESC

targets.rawSql: SELECT (payload->>'recorded_at')::timestamptz AS time,(payload->>'method')||' seed '||(payload->>'seed') AS metric,(payload->>'objective_score')::float AS value FROM extended_records WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND payload->>'record_type'='validation' ORDER BY time

SELECT payload->>'method' AS method,payload->>'seed' AS seed,(payload->>'env_steps')::int AS env_steps,(payload->>'objective_score')::float AS objective FROM extended_records WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND payload->>'record_type'='validation' ORDER BY method,seed,env_steps

panels.title: Mean cost gap to CP-SAT 5s · positive is worse

targets.rawSql: WITH tests AS (SELECT payload AS p FROM extended_records WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND payload->>'record_type'='test'), cp AS (SELECT p->>'instance' AS instance,(p->>'objective_score')::float AS score FROM tests WHERE p->>'method'='CP-SAT' AND (p->>'budget_s')::float=5) SELECT t.p->>'scenario' AS scenario,t.p->>'method' AS method,round(avg(100*((t.p->>'objective_score')::float/cp.score-1))::numeric,2) AS gap_percent,count(*) AS episodes FROM tests t JOIN cp ON t.p->>'instance'=cp.instance WHERE t.p->>'method'!='CP-SAT' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,3

panels.title: Full episode latency and action latency · different units of work

targets.rawSql: SELECT payload->>'method' AS method,payload->>'scenario' AS scenario,COALESCE(payload->>'budget_s','') AS budget_s,round(avg((payload->>'runtime_ms')::numeric),3) AS episode_ms,round(avg((payload->>'mean_inference_ms')::numeric),3) AS action_ms,count(*) AS episodes FROM extended_records WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND payload->>'record_type'='test' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 2,1,3

panels.title: Training runtime, parameters and checkpoint audit

targets.rawSql: SELECT payload->>'method' AS method,payload->>'seed' AS seed,payload->>'env_steps' AS interactions,round((payload->>'training_time_s')::numeric,2) AS seconds,payload->>'parameter_count' AS parameters,payload->>'unused_transitions' AS unused_interactions,payload->>'checkpoint_roundtrip' AS checkpoint_verified FROM extended_records WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND payload->>'record_type'='training_summary' ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT (payload->>'recorded_at')::timestamptz AS time,(payload->>'method')||' seed '||(payload->>'seed') AS metric,(payload->>'train_episode_return')::float AS value FROM extended_records WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND payload->>'record_type'='training' AND payload->>'train_episode_return' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time

SELECT (payload->>'recorded_at')::timestamptz AS time,(payload->>'method')||' seed '||(payload->>'seed')||' '||v.key AS metric,v.value::float AS value FROM extended_records CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(payload) v WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND payload->>'record_type'='training' AND v.key IN ('train_policy_gradient_loss','train_value_loss','train_td_loss') ORDER BY time

SELECT step,payload->>'instance' AS instance,payload->>'scenario' AS scenario,payload->>'method' AS method,payload->>'seed' AS seed,payload->>'budget_s' AS budget_s,payload->>'makespan' AS makespan,payload->>'total_tardiness' AS tardiness,payload->>'objective_score' AS objective,payload->>'runtime_ms' AS runtime_ms,payload->>'constraint_violation_count' AS violations FROM extended_records WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND payload->>'record_type'='test' ORDER BY step
